Hi Tom / Marissa —

Thanks for the materials. Procurement update: 

- We can do a PO but it will need a signed SOW + vendor onboarding packet completed (attached a blank questionnaire). Expect ~3 weeks from submission to PO issuance for new vendors unless there are major legal redlines.
- Marketplace: we can purchase via AWS Marketplace, but only for standard SaaS listings. Dedicated capacity / reserved GPU pools with custom SOW typically require direct contracting. If Redwood can provide a marketplace SKU that maps to the reserved capacity configuration, Procurement will consider it — otherwise PO route.
- Next steps for Marissa: please return the completed vendor questionnaire, and provide a PO-ready invoice (line-itemized by month/quarter) and a final SOW addressing indemnity/data residency notes.

I’ll put a placeholder in our queue for this and update once Legal completes review (I expect an initial pass by 8/20).

Best,
